phase_1.description: Pulling the trigger disengages the sear, freeing the spring-driven hammer or striker to impact the .30-06 Springfield primer.

phase_2.title: Phase 2 · 405 MPa Chamber Pressure Rise
phase_2.description: The propellant charge ignites inside the locked chamber, driving peak pressure to 405 MPa while sealing the cartridge case against the breech.

phase_3.title: Phase 3 · 610 mm Barrel Engraving & Acceleration
phase_3.description: The projectile engages the 4-groove bore and accelerates to 853 m/s (3820 J).

phase_4.title: Phase 4 · Long-Stroke Unlock & Operating Impulse
phase_4.description: Once chamber pressure decays safely, long-stroke gas piston drives carrier free-travel before cam-rotating the locking bolt.

phase_5.title: Phase 5 · Spent Case Extraction & Ejection
phase_5.description: The extractor pulls the fired brass clear of the chamber and pivots it out the ejection port while the recoil spring compresses.

phase_6.title: Phase 6 · Next-Round Stripping & Breech Lockup
phase_6.description: Driven forward by the recoil spring, the breech strips the next round from the 20-round supply and locks solidly into battery.

phase_7.title: Phase 7 · Disconnector Handoff & Sear Reset
phase_7.description: Releasing the trigger hands control cleanly back to the primary sear, leaving the M1918A2 BAR staged for its 350 RPM (slow) / 550 RPM (fast) dual-rate cadence.

zh.headline: 勃朗宁 M1918A2 BAR 自动步枪：1918 年机械传奇与工程剖析
zh.deck: 约翰·勃朗宁在 1917 年为打破一战堑壕僵局设计的 M1918 BAR 开创了「行进间抵腰压制火力」先河；二战定型的 M1918A2 型采用全钢铣削机匣、上倾闭锁连杆与独创枪托内置机械惯性降速器，提供 350 / 550 发/分双档连发射速。 本馆以 1:1 真实工程比例重现其 20 大核心构件与完整工作循环。

acts.title: 时代召唤与研发立项：M1918A2 BAR 的诞生背景
paragraphs: 1918 年问世的 勃朗宁 M1918A2 BAR 自动步枪 由美国约翰·勃朗宁 / 柯尔特 / 温彻斯特主导研制，定位为经典的班用自动步枪。M1918 BAR 跨越一战默兹-阿贡攻势、二战诺曼底与太平洋岛屿战以及朝鲜战争，不仅是美军步兵班的火力中坚，其闭锁原理更通过 FN MAG 延续至今。
约翰·勃朗宁在 1917 年为打破一战堑壕僵局设计的 M1918 BAR 开创了「行进间抵腰压制火力」先河；二战定型的 M1918A2 型采用全钢铣削机匣、上倾闭锁连杆与独创枪托内置机械惯性降速器，提供 350 / 550 发/分双档连发射速。 整件装备总长 1,215 mm（全钢铣削机匣 · 胡桃木托）、空重 8.8 kg，成为同期轻机枪领域最具辨识度的里程碑之一。
acts.audioScript: 第一幕，时代起源。1918 年，美国约翰·勃朗宁 / 柯尔特 / 温彻斯特推出了划时代的勃朗宁 M1918A2 BAR 自动步枪。M1918 BAR 跨越一战默兹-阿贡攻势、二战诺曼底与太平洋岛屿战以及朝鲜战争，不仅是美军步兵班的火力中坚，其闭锁原理更通过 FN MAG 延续至今。 它的核心设计聚焦于上倾铰接闭锁楔块卡入机匣顶部闭锁凹槽，后来倒置演变为传奇的 FN MAG/M240B 闭锁机，奠定了其在轻机枪发展史中的经典地位。
acts.focusPartLabel: 主体机匣与闭锁承力框架

acts.title: 核心机械构造与闭锁奥秘
paragraphs: 勃朗宁 M1918A2 BAR 自动步枪 的机械灵魂在于其「下置长行程导气活塞 · 上倾铰接闭锁楔块 + 双档机械降速器」结构体系。在发射工作循环中，长行程导气活塞带动枪机框完成自由行程并驱动旋转闭锁解锁，将高压能量精确约束于承力框架之内。
制造工艺方面，关键承力件采用发蓝锻钢与油润精选胡桃木/桦木托精加工而成。枪托内置惯性摆锤式机械降速器实现 350 发/分精准慢速连发与 550 发/分快速压制切换，在严苛实战条件下依然保持顺畅节拍与长期尺寸稳定性。
acts.audioScript: 第二幕，核心机械原理。勃朗宁 M1918A2 BAR 自动步枪 采用下置长行程导气活塞 · 上倾铰接闭锁楔块 + 双档机械降速器。在每个击发周期中，长行程导气活塞带动枪机框完成自由行程并驱动旋转闭锁解锁。借助发蓝锻钢与油润精选胡桃木/桦木托工艺与高强度配合，实现了枪托内置惯性摆锤式机械降速器实现 350 发/分精准慢速连发与 550 发/分快速压制切换。
acts.focusPartLabel: 高强度闭锁枪机头与抽壳钩

acts.title: 弹道性能、内膛工艺与实战效能
paragraphs: 该平台配用 .30-06 Springfield 弹药规格与 610 mm（24 in）重型枪管（4 条右旋膛线 · 254 mm / 1:10 缠距），最高工作膛压约 405 MPa，可赋予弹头 853 m/s 的出膛初速与 3,820 J 动能，有效作用距离达 550 米。
内膛技术特点方面，24 英寸长管充分发挥 .30-06 M2 全威力穿甲/普通弹 3,820 J 贯穿威力。同时，3 档外置气体调节缸配合 8.8 kg 沉稳全钢质量有效抑制 .30-06 全威力弹连发跳动，令其在 350 发/分（慢档）/ 550 发/分（快档）双射速 的节奏下兼具精准控制与可靠输出。
acts.audioScript: 第三幕，弹道与实战表现。配备 610 毫米身管与 .30-06 Springfield 口径，勃朗宁 M1918A2 BAR 自动步枪 实现了每秒 853 米的初速与 550 米有效射程。24 英寸长管充分发挥 .30-06 M2 全威力穿甲/普通弹 3,820 J 贯穿威力，展现了卓越的工程平衡。

acts.title: 人机工效、供弹哲学与百年遗产
paragraphs: 围绕 20 发容量的20 发可拆式双排弹匣壳体与 45 mm 膛轴设计，勃朗宁 M1918A2 BAR 自动步枪 将单发后坐冲量控制在 12.1 N·s 水平。A2 型取消单发档改为双档全自动，并加装膛口折叠两脚架与折叠提把。
如今在数字兵器库 3D 百年展厅（BAY-55）中，您可以随时通过三轴剖视、100% 爆炸视图与实时运动学滑块，零距离拆解这座跨越时代的机械工程杰作。
acts.audioScript: 第四幕，百年遗产。凭借 20 发容量的20 发可拆式双排弹匣壳体与出色的整体工效，A2 型取消单发档改为双档全自动，并加装膛口折叠两脚架与折叠提把。欢迎在 BAY-55 展位亲手切开剖面、逐件拆解，感受 勃朗宁 M1918A2 BAR 自动步枪 的机械魅力。

acts.title: Origins & Operational Mandate of the M1918A2 BAR
paragraphs: Introduced in 1918 by John M. Browning / Colt / Winchester in United States, the Browning M1918A2 BAR emerged as a defining Squad Automatic Rifle. Carried from the 1918 Meuse-Argonne offensive through WWII and Korea, the BAR anchored U.S. infantry squads while bequeathing its locking geometry to modern NATO machine guns.

Designed by John Browning to break WWI trench stalemates via “walking fire,” the WWII M1918A2 BAR pairs a milled receiver and rising-link gas action with an ingenious buttstock inertia rate reducer toggling between 350 and 550 RPM. Measuring 1,215 mm (Milled Steel Receiver · Walnut Stock) at an unloaded weight of 8.8 kg, it reshaped expectations across the Machine Gun class.
acts.audioScript: Act One: Historical Origins. In 1918, John M. Browning / Colt / Winchester of United States introduced the Browning M1918A2 BAR. Carried from the 1918 Meuse-Argonne offensive through WWII and Korea, the BAR anchored U.S. infantry squads while bequeathing its locking geometry to modern NATO machine guns. Anchored by its hallmark design trait — Rising hinged locking bolt inspired the inverted locking architecture of the postwar FN MAG/M240B — it quickly established an enduring engineering benchmark.

acts.title: Core Operating Architecture & Lockup Mechanics
paragraphs: At the mechanical heart of the Browning M1918A2 BAR sits its Under-Barrel Long-Stroke Gas Piston · Rising Hinged Locking Link & Dual-Rate Escapement. Throughout every firing cycle, long-stroke gas piston drives carrier free-travel before cam-rotating the locking bolt, containing 405 MPa of operating pressure safely.

Constructed in blued forged ordnance steel paired with oil-finished walnut, the assembly achieves durable field tolerances. Notably, Buttstock inertia rate-reducer mechanism selects between 350 RPM slow-auto and 550 RPM fast-auto, sustaining dependable operation under severe environmental stress.
acts.audioScript: Act Two: Core Mechanical Architecture. The Browning M1918A2 BAR relies on Under-Barrel Long-Stroke Gas Piston · Rising Hinged Locking Link & Dual-Rate Escapement. During each cycle, long-stroke gas piston drives carrier free-travel before cam-rotating the locking bolt. Machined from blued forged ordnance steel paired with oil-finished walnut, it delivers standout engineering reliability: Buttstock inertia rate-reducer mechanism selects between 350 RPM slow-auto and 550 RPM fast-auto.

acts.title: Ballistic Performance, Bore Craft & Range Reach
paragraphs: Chambered for .30-06 Springfield with 610 mm (24 in) Heavy Barrel (4-Groove RH · 1:10" Twist), the Browning M1918A2 BAR develops 853 m/s muzzle velocity and 3,820 J of kinetic energy for effective engagement out to 550 meters.

Internally, 24-inch barrel extracts the full 3,820 J punch of .30-06 Springfield M2 Ball and AP ammunition. Combined with its 350 RPM (slow) / 550 RPM (fast) dual-rate tempo, 3-position gas regulator and 8.8 kg milled-steel mass steady full-power .30-06 bursts, delivering disciplined accuracy across demanding field conditions.
acts.audioScript: Act Three: Ballistic Performance. Driving .30-06 Springfield through its 610 millimeter bore, the Browning M1918A2 BAR achieves 853 meters per second and 550 meters of effective reach. 24-inch barrel extracts the full 3,820 J punch of .30-06 Springfield M2 Ball and AP ammunition.

acts.title: Feed Philosophy, Ergonomics & Centennial Legacy
paragraphs: Fed by a 20-round 20-round detachable magazine body with a 45 mm bore-axis height, the platform manages 12.1 N-s of recoil impulse cleanly. A2 upgrade introduced dual-rate automatic fire, muzzle bipod, and clip-on carrying handle.
Now archived in Digital Armory 3D Centennial Gallery (BAY-55), all 20 interactive assemblies can be sectioned live along three axes, exploded to 100%, and inspected part by part.
